content.text: Assessing the item: part (a) is a standard digit-extraction loop using % and /, which is a familiar, basic pattern. Part (b) requires a loop that calls digitSum and tests divisibility with %. Both are conventional AP FRQ-style methods. The reasoning is short, there is no heavy reading, and there is no long arithmetic. The only subtlety is that the loop condition needs to be right (while n > 0, which handles 0 correctly) and that the search in (b) terminates, since every positive integer has a positive digit sum. This matches a typical Question 1/2-style free-response item with a modest multi-step structure, which makes it appropriate for full mock exams.
